name: civfix-admin
description: civfix admin / operator dashboard workspace (admin.civfix.org). Consumes @civfix/contract and @civfix/tokens from the private npm registry.

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: The only packages allowed to run install scripts; any other dependency that ships one is skipped. All three are postinstalls that verify, and if needed fetch, the native binary their platform package provides: esbuild (vite under vitest, and wrangler), unrs-resolver (eslint-import-resolver-typescript) and workerd (wrangler, the deploy tool). Add a package here only after reading its script.
pnpm.//overrides: Floors for transitive packages whose parent still declares a vulnerable range, each bounded inside the vulnerable package's own major so the fix stays a patch/minor for the requester: vite (vitest peer), js-yaml 4, brace-expansion 1/5, nanoid 3, postcss, browserslist, postcss-selector-parser 6 and source-map-js 1 (eslint, tailwindcss 3, next and vitest DoS and path-traversal advisories); sharp (next still accepts the vulnerable 0.34 line); undici 7 (wrangler pins it through miniflare). Drop each entry once its parent ships the fixed range itself.
pnpm.//auditConfig: GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (postcss-selector-parser quadratic flat-selector parsing) lists every version below 7.1.6 as affected, but postcss-selector-parser 6.1.5 backports that exact fix to the 6.x line tailwindcss 3 requires (Set-based index lookups in parser.js), and the overrides above force 6.1.5 (and 7.1.6+ should a 7.x copy appear, since an ignore covers every version). The parser also only ever sees our own stylesheets at build time. Remove once the advisory lists 6.1.5 as patched or admin moves to Tailwind 4, which drops the package.
